tickets.title: Complete one-time IRA withdrawal for home remodel deposit
tickets.text: Complete Dorian Pebblefizz’s $38,000 gross withdrawal from his traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody and send the funds to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked for a $38,000 gross distribution from the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to be sent to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit, and they agreed to complete the one-time IRA withdrawal by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Change recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Confirm the requested recurring payment change, verify the effective timing with the provider or custodian, and document the old and new payment method or amount without storing unnecessary sensitive details. Raise Dorian Pebblefizz’s regular traditional IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month, document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle, and address the custodian record’s Oregon state withholding discrepancy.
tickets.evidence: Dorian also asked to raise the regular IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month and to document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle; they agreed to complete the recurring IRA distribution adjustment by 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client reports a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. Update Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz’s advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions to reflect their move from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada, in June 2025 and their current primary residence in Henderson.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing. Confirm the Pebblefizz household’s move from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada, in June 2025 and their current primary residence in Henderson.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields. Reflect the household’s new mailing address and primary residence in Henderson, Nevada.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements. Address the custodian record’s Oregon state withholding on recurring IRA payments and update retirement distribution withholding assumptions for the household’s Nevada residency.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: The move from Oregon to Nevada requires advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions to be updated using the new residency facts Dorian provided, and they agreed to complete those updates by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Resolve Oregon withholding discrepancy on recurring IRA payments
tickets.text: Address the custodian record’s Oregon state withholding on Dorian Pebblefizz’s recurring traditional IRA distribution. Confirm the correct withholding assumptions for the household’s Nevada residency and update the custodian record accordingly.
